text:
Assistant B correctly extracts the country, capital, and language for each sentence and returns them as a single valid JSON object keyed by a, b, and c. It also picks up Eldoria as the country in sentence b, which is a fictional place.

Assistant A puts the whole original sentence in the "country" field instead of the country name. That is wrong. It also outputs three separate JSON objects, which is not one valid JSON document.

[[B]]
